results.title: Iran
results.text: On 25 May 2026, Iran agreed to a 12-month framework for phased IAEA inspections following EU-mediated talks in Vienna. The agreement was characterised as a confidence-building step ahead of broader negotiations on the nuclear programme.

results.title: Ukraine
results.text: Ukrainian air defences intercepted 73 drones during overnight strikes on 25 May 2026, the largest single-night total reported during the year. No energy infrastructure damage was reported.

results.title: OpenAI
results.text: OpenAI announced a long-context tier of its API on 25 May 2026, targeting enterprise legal and research workflows with a one-million-token window at a new pricing point.

results.title: Apple Inc.
results.text: Apple reported quarterly results that beat analyst expectations on services revenue, sending its shares up in after-hours trading on 25 May 2026.

results.title: Manchester City F.C.
results.text: Manchester City secured a fifth consecutive Premier League title on 25 May 2026 after a 1-1 draw against Tottenham Hotspur in the final fixture of the season.
